_meta.description: Post-split baseline: measured from the separate entry points (four at the split, plus `yaml` at spec 1.3.0), for tracking future regressions from this point forward. NOT the pre-split measurement — see HISTORICAL_PRE_SPLIT_AGGREGATE in this script and AUDIT_REMEDIATION_AND_RELEASE_PLAN.md 5.1. Re-measured for spec 1.3.0, which took the registry from ten locales to eighteen: every entry grew by roughly the embedded weight of eight more locale files (`text` most visibly, since it is almost nothing else). That is data, not code, and it is not what the 5% budget is for — the budget exists to catch a parser reaching an entry that must not have one, and scripts/check-entry-reach.mjs proves that independently against the real module graph.
